name: Spring Cloud Gateway
description: Structure documentation for Spring Cloud Gateway Actuator API objects

structures.name: RouteDefinition
structures.description: A gateway route that matches incoming requests and forwards them to a destination

fields.name: uri
fields.description: Destination URI (supports lb:// for load-balanced URIs)

fields.name: predicates
fields.description: List of predicate definitions that must all match

fields.name: filters
fields.description: List of filter definitions applied to matched requests

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with the route

structures.name: PredicateDefinition
structures.description: A route predicate definition specifying matching criteria

fields.name: name
fields.description: Predicate factory name (Path, Host, Method, Header, Query, Cookie, Weight)

fields.name: args
fields.description: String key-value arguments for the predicate

structures.name: FilterDefinition
structures.description: A gateway filter definition applied to matched requests or responses

fields.name: name
fields.description: Filter factory name (AddRequestHeader, RewritePath, CircuitBreaker, RequestRateLimiter)

fields.name: args
fields.description: String key-value arguments for the filter
